semiconductor_relevance: Medium — CKD Corporation provides pneumatic systems and components that are used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: CKD Corporation specializes in the production of pneumatic and fluid components, which are essential for automation in semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include pneumatic rotary spindles and pumps, contributing to the efficiency of various processes in the semiconductor value chain.

regional_presence.China: CKD (Shanghai) Corporation serves as the sales subsidiary in China, focusing on expanding their market presence and service capabilities.
